arxiv-2102-00388.title: Evaluations of certain Catalan-Hankel Pfaffians via classical skew orthogonal polynomials
arxiv-2102-00388.creator: Bo-Jian Shen, Shi-Hao Li, Guo-Fu Yu
arxiv-2102-00388.description: Abstract . This paper is to evaluate certain Catalan-Hankel Pfaffians by the theory of skew orthogonal polynomials. Due to different kinds of hypergeometric orthogonal polynomials underlying the Askey scheme, we explicitly construct the classical skew orthogonal polynomials and then give different examples of Catalan-Hankel Pfaffians with continuous and q q -moment sequences. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 15A15, 33E20 1.

arxiv-2103-06088.creator: Marcelo Actis † , Pedro Morin † , and Cornelia Schneider ∗
arxiv-2103-06088.description: Abstract . We study approximation classes for adaptive time-stepping finite element methods for time-dependent Partial Differential Equations (PDE). We measure the approximation error in L 2 ​ ( [ 0 , T ) × Ω ) L_{2}([0,T)\times\Omega) and consider the approximation with discontinuous finite elements in time and continuous finite elements in space, of any degree.

arxiv-2104-03347.title: Top Score in Axelrod Tournament
arxiv-2104-03347.creator: Frederick M. Vincent, Dashiell E.A. Fryer
arxiv-2104-03347.description: Abstract The focus of the project will be an examination of obtaining the highest score in the Axelrod Tournament. The initial design of the highest score in the Axelrod Tournament consisted of looking at the Cooperation rates of the top strategies currently in the Axelrod Library.

arxiv-2104-04755.title: Preprocessing Methods of Lane Detection and Tracking for Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2104-04755.creator: Akram Heidarizadeh
arxiv-2104-04755.description: Abstract In the past few years, researches on advanced driver assistance systems (ADASs) have been carried out and deployed in intelligent vehicles. Systems that have been developed can perform different tasks, such as lane keeping assistance (LKA), lane departure warning (LDW), lane change warning (LCW) and adaptive cruise control (ACC).

arxiv-2106-14433.title: Efficient Dialogue State Tracking by Masked Hierarchical Transformer

arxiv-2106-14433.description: Abstract This paper describes our approach to DSTC 9 Track 2: Cross-lingual Multi-domain Dialog State Tracking , the task goal is to build a cross-lingual dialog state tracker with a training set in rich resource language and a testing set in low resource language.

arxiv-2307-03597.title: An apparent positive relation between spin and orbital angular momentum in X-ray binaries 2022 An apparent positive relation between spin and orbital angular momentum in X-ray binaries – References
arxiv-2307-03597.creator: Zhen Yan, Wenda Zhang, Wenfei Yu
arxiv-2307-03597.description: Abstract The origin of current angular momentum (AM) of the black hole (BH) in X-ray binary (XRB) is still unclear, which is related with the birth and/or the growth of the BH. Here we collect the spin parameters a ∗ a_{*} measured in BH XRBs and find an apparent bimodal distribution centered at ∼ \sim 0.17 and 0.83.

arxiv-2402-06093.title: Formal Verification of the Sumcheck Protocol
arxiv-2402-06093.creator: Azucena Garvía Bosshard azucena.garvia-bosshard@alumni.ethz.ch Independent Researcher † Jonathan Bootle jbt@zurich.ibm.com IBM Research Europe – Zurich Christoph Sprenger sprenger@inf.ethz.ch ETH Zurich
arxiv-2402-06093.description: Abstract The sumcheck protocol, introduced in 1992, is an interactive proof which is a key component of many probabilistic proof systems in computational complexity theory and cryptography, some of which have been deployed. However, none of these proof systems based on the sumcheck protocol enjoy a formally-verified security analysis.

arxiv-2403-02197.title: Solvable and non-solvable finite groups of the same order type
arxiv-2403-02197.creator: Paweł Piwek
arxiv-2403-02197.description: Abstract . We construct two finite groups of size 2 365 ⋅ 3 105 ⋅ 7 104 2^{365}\cdot 3^{105}\cdot 7^{104} : a solvable group G G and a non-solvable group H H , such that for every integer n n the groups have the same number of elements of order n n .

arxiv-2411-13082.title: Patience Is The Key to Large Language Model Reasoning
arxiv-2411-13082.creator: Yijiong Yu
arxiv-2411-13082.description: Abstract Recent advancements in the field of large language models, particularly through the Chain of Thought (CoT) approach, have demonstrated significant improvements in solving complex problems. However, existing models either tend to sacrifice detailed reasoning for brevity due to user preferences, or require extensive and expensive training data to learn complicated reasoning ability, limiting their potential in solving complex tasks.

arxiv-2505-07926.title: Constraining anomalous 𝑾 ​ 𝒕 ​ 𝒃 Wtb and related SMEFT couplings using low-energy and electroweak precision observables
arxiv-2505-07926.creator: Subhajit Kala, Lipika Kolay, Lopamudra Mukherjee, and Soumitra Nandi
arxiv-2505-07926.description: Abstract We investigate constraints on couplings of Standard Model effective field theory (SMEFT) operators contributing to W ​ t ​ b Wtb effective vertex at tree level. We study the one-loop level impact of these couplings on the low-energy flavour changing charged and neutral current processes and on the electroweak precision observables.

arxiv-2507-09782.title: Physics-informed neural networks for high-dimensional solutions and snaking bifurcations in nonlinear lattices Journal: Physica D: Nonlinear Phenomena
arxiv-2507-09782.creator: Muhammad Luthfi Shahab, Fidya Almira Suheri, Rudy Kusdiantara, Hadi Susanto
arxiv-2507-09782.description: Abstract This paper introduces a framework based on physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for addressing key challenges in nonlinear lattices, including solution approximation, bifurcation diagram construction, and linear stability analysis. We first employ PINNs to approximate solutions of nonlinear systems arising from lattice models, using the Levenberg–Marquardt algorithm to optimize network weights for greater accuracy.

arxiv-2601-04388.title: LLM-Guided Lifecycle-Aware Clustering of Multi-Turn Customer Support Conversations
arxiv-2601-04388.creator: Priyaranjan Pattnayak, Sanchari Chowdhuri, Amit Agarwal
arxiv-2601-04388.description: Abstract Clustering customer chat data is vital for cloud providers handling multi-service queries. Traditional methods struggle with overlapping concerns and create broad, static clusters that degrade over time. Re-clustering disrupts continuity, making issue tracking difficult. We propose an adaptive system that segments multi-turn chats into service-specific concerns and incrementally refines clusters as new issues arise.

arxiv-2601-17087.title: Lost in Simulation: LLM-Simulated Users are Unreliable Proxies for Human Users in Agentic Evaluations
arxiv-2601-17087.creator: Preethi Seshadri Samuel Cahyawijaya Ayomide Odumakinde, Sameer Singh Seraphina Goldfarb-Tarrant, [0.4em] UC Irvine Cohere [0.4em] {preethis, sameer}@uci.edu {samuelcahyawijaya, ayomideodumakinde, seraphina}@cohere.com
arxiv-2601-17087.description: Abstract Agentic benchmarks increasingly rely on LLM-simulated users to scalably evaluate agent performance, yet the robustness, validity, and fairness of this approach remain unexamined. Through a user study with participants across the United States, India, Kenya, and Nigeria, we investigate whether LLM-simulated users serve as reliable proxies for real human users in evaluating agents on τ \tau -Bench retail tasks.

pmc-10582759.title: Preservation of circadian rhythm in hepatocellular cancer
pmc-10582759.creator: Yanyan Yang, Ashraf N Abdo, Hiroaki Kawara, Christopher P Selby, Aziz Sancar
pmc-10582759.description: Circadian rhythms are controlled at the cellular level by a molecular clock consisting of several genes/proteins engaged in a transcription–translation–degradation feedback loop. Regarding circadian control in neoplastic tissues, reports to date have demonstrated anomalous circadian function in tumor models and cultured tumor cells.

pmc-10668714.description: Candida albicans is an opportunistic yeast that causes most fungal infections. C. albicans has become increasingly resistant to antifungal drugs over the past decade. pmc-11493980.title: Identification of KW-2449 as a dual inhibitor of ferroptosis and necroptosis reveals that autophagy is a targetable pathway for necroptosis inhibitors to prevent ferroptosis
pmc-11493980.creator: Yaxing Zhao, Qingsong Wang, Jing Zhu, Jin Cai, Xiaona Feng, Qianqian Song, Hui Jiang, Wenqing Ren, Yuan He, Ping Wang, Du Feng, Jianqiang Yu, Yue Liu, Qihui Wu, Jitkaew Siriporn, Zhenyu Cai
pmc-11493980.description: Necroptosis and ferroptosis are two distinct forms of necrotic-like cell death in terms of their morphological features and regulatory mechanisms. These two types of cell death can coexist in disease and contribute to pathological processes. Inhibition of both necroptosis and ferroptosis has been shown to enhance therapeutic effects in treating complex necrosis-related diseases.

pmc-12567279.title: Escitalopram Dose Optimization During Pregnancy: A PBPK Modeling Approach
pmc-12567279.creator: Seo-Yeon Choi, Eunsol Yang, Kwang-Hee Shin
pmc-12567279.description: Background/Objectives: Escitalopram, a first-line antidepressant, is primarily metabolized by CYP2C19. Its pharmacokinetics are altered during pregnancy. This study aims to predict maternal and fetal exposure to escitalopram during pregnancy and to propose safe and effective dosing strategies using physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling.

Circulating noncoding RNAs (ncRNAs) play significant roles in malignancy detection and prognosis.
